title: Points: re-voting re-scores — one ballot, N casts, N payouts
desc:
Defect (sibling of t-20261011-6891, same audit): `cmd_vote` appends one type=vote bus message per cast and re-voting is allowed — `collect_votes` (bin/chatcode ~1134) documents "Later votes replace earlier ones", so the TALLY counts one ballot per agent, but `compute_points` (~975) pays +25/+10 for EVERY vote message. Measured in a throwaway --local repo: alice votes accept-inspected, then changes to deny-inspected (one ballot, two casts) and reads 50 points; the tally correctly shows 1 vote from alice (a later bob accept-trusted closes at a 1A/1D tie). Cast 10 times = 250 points with the tally untouched — a points-farming vector, and honest mind-changers are overpaid.

Fix shape (mirror of t-6891): scoring, not records — compute_points keeps, for each (ref, from) pair, only the LAST vote message by bus order (msgs arrive ts-sorted, stable, so append order breaks ties within a second); earlier casts stay on the bus, unscored. No schema change.

Acceptance: red on main / green on branch test asserting: two casts by one agent on one task = 25 once (not 50); three casts = 25; the same agent voting on TWO different tasks still scores each ballot; the tally still resolves with the last ballot (tie case preserved); every cast record remains on the bus. Plus the full suite green.
